name: vidshelf
description: Small full-stack video sharing app: NestJS + MongoDB + MinIO API, React + Vite + Tailwind web client.

scripts.build: npm --workspace api run build && npm --workspace web run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace api run lint && npm --workspace web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace api run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm --workspace api run test && npm --workspace web run test
